kind: Actual C16 final-design-pass1 bounded fresh review

viewing_basis: All eight exact original paths were actually opened with tools.view_image and visually inspected. Same declared SHA values did not substitute for per-case viewing. Expected PNGs were used only as each case's source-composition oracle, never as design references. No crops, processing, diagnostic difference PNGs, or extra images were opened.

Speech marks and the black arch are visible; lower artwork reaches the bottom without a footer covering the rays or arch. Slim white side strips and all panel borders are also visible in this case's own expected composition. Its own processed original shows the same artwork borders and bubbles, with no footer captions.
cases.reference_observation: The exact reference includes a top-right bookmark ribbon, a lower-left chapter caption and a lower-right page counter. These visible app additions are absent from the current native image, as required by the user override. Content framing follows this case's own source composition rather than stretching it to the reference's edge-to-edge presentation.
cases.pure_reader_visibility: No visible app ribbon, footer, page/status label, download notice, debug decoration or overlay. Source panel rules and speech marks have direct provenance in this case's separately viewed processed original and expected oracle.
cases.glyph_and_clipping: Artwork marks and heavy panel boundaries remain readable; no observed unintended clipping of the outer panels, speech bubbles, radial region or arch relative to the own source/oracle.
cases.intentional_and_capability_checks: The reference footer and ribbon are intentionally removed. A closed still image gives no evidence for hidden footer-cycle hit regions, recovery or live operation.

The white side strips are part of the expected source composition, with no bottom caption region.

limitations: Exact typeface and 500/700 weights were not measured. These selected artwork-only captures contain no app text to qualify those attributes; this is a bounded limitation, not indefinite reading pending.
Case/state/metadata/action/log SHA values are retained from the owner input. Their contents and mechanical assertions were not used for this visual acceptance.
No resume or normal-use sequence, hidden hit area, physical input, rotation, sleep/wake, framebuffer behavior, e-ink effect, hardware behavior, performance or live-reader lease was observed.
The global final manifest remains owner-pending and is not a gate for the authorized sealed module review. This report gives no whole-round, clean, packaging or pass2 qualification.
conclusion: Both assigned cases satisfy the bounded visible artwork-only and composition contracts. No evidence-backed new required issue, unreadable assigned detail or identity mismatch was observed.
